svg.title: R2DBC Lettuce Cache Sequence
svg.desc: Sequence diagram for NearCache, Redis loaded map, R2DBC loader, write-through or write-behind writer, and delete or clear cache behavior.
svg.text: Reads short-circuit from NearCache or Redis; misses and DB writes pass through Exposed R2DBC loader/writer transactions.

g.id: a t c a t s

svg.text: Boundary rule: clearCache clears NearCache and Redis only; DB row changes happen through R2DBC writer paths.
